title: 1908 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship
text:
{{Short description|none}} {{Use dmy dates|date=April 2022}} {{Infobox Hurling All-Ireland | year = 1908 | image = | dates = | teams = | connacht = Galway | munster = Tipperary | leinster = Dublin | ulster = Derry | matches = | poty = | team = Tipperary | titles = 8th | captain = [[Tom Semple]] | manager = | team2 = Dublin | captain2 = [[Jack Grace (Gaelic footballer)|Jack Grace]] | manager2 = | totalgoals = | totalpoints = | topscorer = | previous = [[All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship 1907|1907]] | next = [[All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship 1909|1909]] }} The '''All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship 1908''' was the 22nd series of the [[All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship]], [[Ireland]]'s premier [[hurling]] [[single-elimination tournament|knock-out competition]]. [[Tipperary GAA|Tipperary]] won the championship, beating [[Dublin GAA|Dublin]] 3–15 to 1–5 in a replay of the [[1908 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final|final]].{{cite web|url=http://gaaweb.sitesuite.cn/page/roll_of_honour2.html |title=All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Roll of Honour |publisher=The GAA website |access-date=26 July 2011 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110905085701/http://gaaweb.sitesuite.cn/page/roll_of_honour2.html |archive-date=5 September 2011 }} ==Format== '''All-Ireland Championship''' ''Semi-finals:'' (2 matches) The four provincial representatives made up the semi-final pairings. Two teams are eliminated at this stage while the two winning teams advance to the All-Ireland final. ''Final:'' (1 match) The winners of the two semi-finals contest this game with the winners being declared All-Ireland champions. ==Results== ===[[Connacht Senior Hurling Championship]]=== {{footballbox | date =31 January 1909
Final | team1 = [[Galway GAA|Galway]] | score = 3–5 – 1–2 | team2 = [[Roscommon GAA|Roscommon]] | goals1 = | goals2 = | stadium = [[Tuam]] | attendance = }} ===[[Leinster Senior Hurling Championship]]=== {{footballbox | date = 7 March 1909
Final | team1 = {{GG|Dublin|hurling}} | score = w/o – scr. | team2 = {{GG|Kilkenny|hurling}} | goals1 = | goals2 = | stadium = [[Jones' Road]], [[Dublin]] }} ''Kilkenny refused to play due a dispute over the [[Railway Shield]].'' ===[[Munster Senior Hurling Championship]]=== {{footballbox | date = Final | team1 = {{GG|Tipperary|hurling}} | score = w/o – scr. | team2 = {{GG|Kerry|hurling}} | goals1 = | goals2 = | stadium = }} ===[[Ulster Senior Hurling Championship]]=== {{footballbox | date = Semi-final | team1 = [[Cavan GAA|Cavan]] | score = 3–6 – 0–3 | team2 = [[Fermanagh GAA|Fermanagh]] | goals1 = | goals2 = | stadium = }} {{footballbox | date = Final | team1 = [[Derry GAA|Derry]] | score = 2–8 – 0–2 | team2 = [[Cavan GAA|Cavan]] | goals1 = | goals2 = | stadium = }} ===[[All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship]]=== {{footballbox | date = 14 February 1909
